id.description: The file's id: pass it to `POST /files/{file_id}/download-link/`. Every daily file gets a new id. Old ids still download.

dataset.description: Which dataset this file is a snapshot of: `coop_up2data`, `coop_harvestapi` and `coop_fetchin` are the co-op files: every LinkedIn profile fetched through Up2Data, through HarvestAPI and through Fetchin, one flat Parquet table each (columns: docs Dataset fields), rebuilt every day. `GET /files/` lists the newest file of each dataset.

filename.description: The download's file name, such as `coop_up2data.parquet`.

row_count.description: Rows in the file. `null` when we have not counted it.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256, in hex, to check your download. `null` when we have not measured it.

is_unlocked.description: Whether this workspace may download it: `true` once this workspace has added $50 in funds.
